# Action Reference

The built-in actions of the action catalogue (spec Appendix D), generated from the descriptors in `schema/actions/`. A step of an action graph names an action, gives its inputs as prop values and continues through `next`, `onSuccess`, `onError` or the action's named branches ([document model](document-model.md#5-action-graphs)). Type parameters are bound by the compiler from the step's context. Each action is implemented in the phase shown; the compiler rejects actions whose phase has not been delivered. IDs are permanent (`BND-011`).

| Action | Category | Phase | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [apiCall](#apicall) | data | P5 | Calls a declared REST or GraphQL operation and returns its typed response. |
| [biometricAuth](#biometricauth) | security | P6 | Asks the user to confirm with a biometric or the device credential; takes the success or failure branch. |
| [callFlow](#callflow) | control | P5 | Runs a reusable named action graph with typed input and returns its output (ACT-061). |
| [callNative](#callnative) | host | P4 | Invokes a custom action the host app registered, with typed input and output (ACT-060). |
| [capturePhoto](#capturephoto) | device | P5 | Takes a photo with the camera. |
| [condition](#condition) | control | P4 | Takes the then branch when a PXL condition holds, otherwise the else branch. |
| [controlAnimation](#controlanimation) | animation | P5 | Plays, pauses, reverses, seeks or stops a timeline. |
| [copyToClipboard](#copytoclipboard) | device | P5 | Copies text to the clipboard; blocked on secure pages. |
| [dbDelete](#dbdelete) | localDb | P5 | Deletes the record with a key; deleting a missing record succeeds. |
| [dbInsert](#dbinsert) | localDb | P5 | Inserts a record into a local collection and returns its key. |
| [dbQuery](#dbquery) | localDb | P5 | Returns the records of a collection that match a filter, in order. |
| [dbUpdate](#dbupdate) | localDb | P5 | Updates fields of the record with a key; fails if it does not exist. |
| [dbUpsert](#dbupsert) | localDb | P5 | Inserts a record, or replaces the record with the same key. |
| [delay](#delay) | control | P5 | Waits for a duration; the wait is cancelled with the run. |
| [emitHostEvent](#emithostevent) | host | P4 | Sends a typed event to the host app. |
| [forEach](#foreach) | control | P5 | Runs the body branch once per item of a list, in order, bounded by the list length and the action.forEachItems limit (ACT-005). |
| [getLocation](#getlocation) | device | P5 | Reads the device's current position once. |
| [haptic](#haptic) | feedback | P5 | Plays a haptic feedback pattern. |
| [invokeFunction](#invokefunction) | compute | P7 | Calls a Plux Function with typed input and output, on the device or the server according to its placement. |
| [kvGet](#kvget) | localDb | P5 | Reads a value from the plugin's key-value store. |
| [kvRemove](#kvremove) | localDb | P5 | Removes a key from the plugin's key-value store. |
| [kvSet](#kvset) | localDb | P5 | Writes a value to the plugin's key-value store. |
| [logout](#logout) | host | P5 | Signals logout to the host app, which wipes plugin data according to its policy. |
| [navigate](#navigate) | navigation | P4 | Pushes, replaces, pops until or clears and pushes a Plux route or native route with typed parameters. |
| [openBottomSheet](#openbottomsheet) | navigation | P4 | Presents a bottom-sheet page and waits for its result. |
| [openDialog](#opendialog) | navigation | P4 | Presents a dialog page and waits for its result. |
| [openUrl](#openurl) | navigation | P5 | Opens an external URL on an allowlisted domain, or a deep link, outside the app. |
| [parallel](#parallel) | control | P5 | Runs the named branches concurrently and continues when all have finished; the first error cancels the others. |
| [patchState](#patchstate) | state | P5 | Merges fields into an object state entry; with optimistic set, the patch is rolled back if a later step of the run fails (ACT-007). |
| [pickFile](#pickfile) | device | P5 | Lets the user pick files. |
| [pickImage](#pickimage) | device | P5 | Lets the user pick images from the photo library. |
| [pop](#pop) | navigation | P4 | Pops the current page, optionally returning a typed result to the page that opened it. |
| [refreshData](#refreshdata) | data | P5 | Reloads a data source, bypassing its cache. |
| [requestPermission](#requestpermission) | device | P5 | Requests a device permission the plugin declares; takes the granted or denied branch. |
| [resetForm](#resetform) | forms | P5 | Resets every field of a form to its initial value and clears its errors. |
| [resetState](#resetstate) | state | P5 | Resets a state entry to its declared initial value. |
| [scanCode](#scancode) | device | P5 | Scans a QR code or barcode with the camera. |
| [setLocale](#setlocale) | app | P8 | Changes the app's locale to one it supports. |
| [setState](#setstate) | state | P5 | Writes a value to a state entry. |
| [setThemeMode](#setthememode) | app | P8 | Changes the app's theme mode. |
| [share](#share) | device | P5 | Opens the platform share sheet with text, a URL or a picked file. |

| [trackEvent](#trackevent) | analytics | P5 | Records a custom telemetry event with typed properties. |

| [validateForm](#validateform) | forms | P5 | Validates every field of a form and shows the errors; takes the valid or invalid branch. |

### apiCall

Calls a declared REST or GraphQL operation and returns its typed response.

ID 16 · data · P5 · effects: network

Type parameters:

- `I` — The input object type the operation declares.
- `O` — The response type the operation declares.
- `T` — The type of each optimistic state value, checked per entry against its state path.

| Input | ID | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | 1 | `string`, required | — | The operation. Names a operation. |
| `input` | 2 | `I` | — | The operation's input: path, query and body values. |
| `optimistic` | 3 | `map<string,T>` | — | State entries to set immediately and roll back if the call fails (ACT-007). |

Output: `O`.
